rationale: The story is regulatory and contractual, centered on two specific IRS forms and a deadline. A document flat-lay on a desk is the most direct, non-literal way to make the tax mechanics visible without resorting to studio abstraction.
subject: an IRS Form 6251 tax worksheet and Form 3921 exercise notice resting on a warm oak home office desk
core_thesis: The real cost of exercising a vested stock option is the alternative minimum tax on the exercise spread, not the strike price, and ISO status expires three months after employment ends.
core_conflict: The tension between the tax-advantaged promise of an ISO and the hidden AMT trigger on the spread, compressed by the 90-day platform deadline and the strict three-month legal cutoff.
